with open\('/home/runner/workspace/public/dashboard.html', 'r'\) as f:
    content = f.read\(\)

# Find the start of the second <script> tag \(the inline one, after the src tag\)
marker = '<script src="/dashboard.js"></script>'
idx = content.find\(marker\)
if idx == -1:
    print\("ERROR: marker not found"\)
    exit\(1\)

# Keep everything up to and including the src script tag, then close the doc
keep = content[:idx + len\(marker\)]
tail = '\\n\\n</body>\\n</html>\\n'

with open\('/home/runner/workspace/public/dashboard.html', 'w'\) as f:
    f.write\(keep + tail\)

print\("Done. File length:", len\(keep + tail\), "chars"\)
